twitter.text:
Ancillary benefits get called “extras” a lot. In reality, they behave more like the plumbing of a protection strategy.

Dental, vision, life, and disability each absorb a slice of risk the medical plan doesn’t fully touch. Together, they fill the space between everyday out-of-pocket costs and the rare, catastrophic events everyone hopes never happen.

When you treat those lines as infrastructure instead of add-ons, the finance conversation shifts from “What can we trim?” to “Which risks are we choosing to carry as an employer versus shift to employees?” That’s a different mindset (and a different bar) for plan design.

Where have you seen ancillary lines quietly doing this infrastructure work in your clients’ portfolios?

#RenaissanceBenefits #AncillaryBenefits #RiskManagement

Health coverage has changed. For many people, higher deductibles and more cost sharing are now part of how their healthcare works.

RenSecureHealth supplemental health sits next to medical coverage and pays cash benefits for certain covered conditions.

Within the Renaissance portfolio, RenSecureHealth works alongside dental, vision, life, and disability, giving employers and brokers more ways to shape a modern benefits mix.

Our Indianapolis team came together this week for the African American Coalition Team’s (ACT) third annual Juneteenth Luncheon, a meaningful time to share a meal, connect with one another and reflect on a pivotal moment in American history.

The event brought team members together for camaraderie, conversation and the chance to support local vendors, creating space for both celebration and reflection. We’re grateful to ACT for leading another thoughtful gathering and for helping make this tradition part of how we come together at Renaissance.

#Juneteenth #RenaissanceBenefits #TeamRenaissance #WorkplaceCulture
